id: AT-STATE-ROOT-01 (state-root: the old default root is read, never written)
note: STATE-ROOT (0.1.2): the default handoff_root is ~/.local/state/<plugin>/handoffs; while handoff_root is unset (or equal to the default), the old default ~/.claude/handoffs is read too. (a) locate pools the buckets of both roots by date and reads an old-root file as own store, and a newer twin there supersedes; tier 5 counts one <repo>/<bucket> in both roots as one bucket, two repos' buckets of one name as two; (b) an explicit other root, or ~/.claude/handoffs set explicitly, is the only root; (c) a session whose pin and /clear lineage are only in the old root keeps its chain and bucket, its next stage, publish and pin under the new root; (d) a successor claim in the old root blocks a second claim in the new one, so a once approval is never lent twice; (e) a handoff published in the old root links and carries its checked approval, its hash record read there, the pin naming the bucket under the new root; (f) pin, begin, stamp and publish write nothing under the old root (tree unchanged); status shows the old root's line only for the default root; (c2) a session that pins another repo's handoff in the old root still reaches it through the pinned bucket's old-root twin (tier 4); (g) a previous compaction copy and a queue lane name come from the old root when only it holds them; (h) a stage begun before the update (its settings name the old root) publishes into the new root while handoff_root is the default: the handoff, pin and records go there and nothing under the old root's .sessions or .watch changes; (i) evidence kept before the update stays in the old root's bucket, so publish refuses a restart recipe citing it (recipe-script) until the script is kept again, which lands it in the new root (README: Known limits of the move).
